name: Nicole Kidman Dance AI: Do the Viral Routine With One Photo
blurb: The Nicole Kidman dance is the viral TikTok routine to ADÉLA's 2026 song "Nicole Kidman": hands to the chest, a hip sway, both arms straight up and a spin with a hair flip.

prompts.label: 1. The video prompt is filled in. Settings: Seedance 2.5, 13 s, 720p, 9:16, sound off. The video prompt
prompts.text:
Recreate the reference video [Video 1] shot for shot: the same narrow alley at night with brick walls, pipes, stairs and doors, the same warm orange street lamps, the same handheld wide-angle phone camera that moves backward in front of the dancer, the same framing, timing and dance moves. The ONLY change: the young woman who dances toward the camera is now the person in [Image 1].

The dancer = the person in [Image 1], in every frame: copy the exact face from [Image 1] - face shape, eye color and eye shape, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, hair color, hair length and hairstyle, and any beard, moustache, glasses or freckles exactly as in the photo. The same real person in every frame, from the first second to the last, so their friends instantly recognize them, also when the face comes close to the camera. Never morph, never drift back to the original dancer's face, never add or remove facial hair. No long black hair unless [Image 1] shows it. The dancer has the body and the clothes of the person in [Image 1], never the black tank top and the black leggings of the original dancer; if [Image 1] shows only the head or the upper body, invent the rest so it matches naturally.

The dance, matching the reference second by second, on the beat:
0-2 s: walks toward the camera and points at the lens, smiling.
2-4 s: leans close to the camera, then puts both hands flat on the chest.
4-7 s: sways the hips, slides the hands down to the waist and up to the shoulders.
7-10 s: walks on, hands at the waist, a small shoulder shimmy.
10-12 s: hands by the head, then both arms straight up overhead.
12-13 s: spins around with a hair flip.

Anatomy rules: one head only, on the dancer's shoulders. Two arms and two hands, no extra limbs. No text, no logos, no watermark, no extra people.

prompts.text: [Video 1] is a motion guide only. Copy its camera moves, timing and dance moves, the sunny city sidewalk with tall palm trees, the bus stop with a bench and a glass shelter, the red curb, the bus that drives past, the traffic and the green hills in the distance, filmed with a handheld phone camera. Do NOT copy the dog in [Video 1]: not its tan fur, face, ears or black collar. Replace it completely. The dancer is the pet in [Image 1], standing upright on its hind legs like a person the whole time. Keep the face, fur colors, markings, ears and body from [Image 1] in every shot, with no collar unless [Image 1] shows one. The pet waits at the bus stop while the bus drives past, then turns to the camera and dances on the beat: low squats with the front paws at the chest, side steps, a hip sway, a front paw waved in the air and a little hop, then it stands tall and looks down the street. Photorealistic, like a real phone video on a sunny day. One continuous shot. No text, no letters, no signs with words, no logos, no watermark, no extra animals.
